name: The Veiled Vanguard
bio: No footsteps, no face under the hood. She drifts in ahead of everyone and is gone before the smoke clears.
notes: New model 2026-11-26 (owner, 2026-11-26: "Vanguard's replacement is the dark hooded character"; she; id and place kept, renamed from Luther Vanguard as the name no longer fit; she floats like the Baseball Robot: `locomotion: roll`, legs still, no walk cycle; owner 2026-11-27: she hovers, `locomotion: hover`, 0.3 m up). Luther Vanguard's model until 2026-11-26 (a Meshy Community CC0 model "A futuristic warrior character") no longer ships. Drive intake of 2026-11-26 ("Dark Hooded Entity 15k", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs). Name and bio are ours (the owner can rename her). Licence: Meshy, owned: the owner's own Meshy model (owner, 2026-11-26: the batch is the owner's own Meshy creations, "Meshy, owned"; standing rule since 2026-11-22).
